description.ko: teler HTTP 침입 탐지(IDS) 알림을 웹훅으로 수신하고 조회·통계를 제공하는 에이전트입니다. 전용 화면이 없어 좌측 메뉴에는 표시되지 않으며, AI 어시스턴트를 통해 질의응답으로 사용합니다.
description.en: Agent that receives teler HTTP intrusion detection (IDS) alerts via webhook and provides queries and statistics. It has no dedicated screen and does not appear in the left menu — use it via Q&A through the AI Assistant.

name: Teler HTTP IDS
description_en: teler HTTP Intrusion Detection System alert receiver. Accepts webhook POSTs from teler, stores alerts in an in-memory deque, and exposes query/stats endpoints. It has no dedicated screen and does not appear in the left menu — use it via Q&A through the AI Assistant.

endpoints.description: List alerts with optional category/severity filter

env_vars.description: Maximum alerts kept in memory (deque maxlen)
